# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.8 Worker 1: Religio Romana Capitoline Hexapantheon (oe_romp_). Generated by gen_romp_pantheon.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Unconditionally unlock omens on hellenism_religion (no D008 DLC lock).
oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = {
	religion:hellenism_religion = {
		set_variable = {
			name = hellenism_has_omens
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

# Unlock a new god for seating via Hexapantheon consecration (SHORT = sol_invictus, juno, ...).
oe_romp_unlock_god = {
	set_variable = oe_romp_unlocked_$SHORT$
}

# Remove any of the 10 v9.8 new gods not currently seated (strictly enforces 2 ADM + 2 DIP + 2 MIL = 6 active gods).
oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_juno_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_vesta_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_janus_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_apollo_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_quirinus_mars_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_quirinus_mars_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_mithras_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_mithras_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_cybele_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_cybele_god
	}
}

# Restore ADM pillar to its 2 default vanilla deities (zeus_god + aphrodite_god).
oe_romp_reset_adm_pillar = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus }
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
		add_god = god:zeus_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite }
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
		add_god = god:aphrodite_god
	}
}

# Restore DIP pillar to its 2 default vanilla deities (poseidon_god + hermes_god).
oe_romp_reset_dip_pillar = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_poseidon }
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_poseidon
		add_god = god:poseidon_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes }
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
		add_god = god:hermes_god
	}
}

# Restore MIL pillar to its 2 default vanilla deities (athena_god + ares_god).
oe_romp_reset_mil_pillar = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_quirinus_mars_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars

		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele }
		remove_god = god:oe_romp_cybele_god
		remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_athena }
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_athena
		add_god = god:athena_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_ares }
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_ares
		add_god = god:ares_god
	}
}

# Restore all 3 pillars (2 ADM + 2 DIP + 2 MIL = 6 active gods) and ensure omens unlocked.
oe_romp_reset_hexapantheon = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	oe_romp_reset_adm_pillar = yes
	oe_romp_reset_dip_pillar = yes
	oe_romp_reset_mil_pillar = yes
	oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
}

# Seat oe_romp_sol_invictus_god into ADM pillar (keeps strictly 2 ADM gods; prefers displacing aphrodite_god to preserve zeus_god).
oe_romp_seat_sol_invictus = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite } }
			remove_god = god:aphrodite_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus } }
			remove_god = god:zeus_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
		}
		set_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
		add_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
	}
}

# Re-seat vanilla zeus_god into ADM pillar (keeps strictly 2 ADM gods).
oe_romp_seat_zeus = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite } }
			remove_god = god:aphrodite_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
		}
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
		add_god = god:zeus_god
	}
}

# Re-seat vanilla aphrodite_god into ADM pillar (keeps strictly 2 ADM gods).
oe_romp_seat_aphrodite = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus } }
			remove_god = god:zeus_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
		}
		remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
		add_god = god:aphrodite_god
	}
}

		}

		add_god = god:poseidon_god

# Seat a new ADM god into the anchor seat (displaces zeus_god first; keeps strictly 2 ADM gods).
# Usage: oe_romp_swap_adm_anchor = { NEW_SHORT = <short> }
oe_romp_swap_adm_anchor = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_$NEW_SHORT$ } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus } }
			remove_god = god:zeus_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite } }
			remove_god = god:aphrodite_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
		}
		set_variable = oe_romp_seated_$NEW_SHORT$
		add_god = god:oe_romp_$NEW_SHORT$_god
	}
}

# Seat a new DIP god into the anchor seat (displaces poseidon_god first; keeps strictly 2 DIP gods).

			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_poseidon

		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes } }
			remove_god = god:hermes_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
